title: risk: misleading error codes in keystore (ERR_KDF_WEAK, ERR_CBOR reuse)
description: Two error code misuses: (1) wp11_keystore_load() returns WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_KDF_WEAK when iter > INT_MAX. The issue is out-of-range, not weak KDF -- a value of 0x80000001 is neither weak nor valid. Add WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_BAD_ITER or return ERR_CBOR (format violation). (2) wp11_keystore_detect_key_type() returns ERR_CBOR when DER parsing fails. DER failure is not CBOR; add WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_INVALID_DER or use ERR_CRYPTO. Both mislead callers diagnosing failures.
